direction_name: Knowledge Substrate — living wiki/memory organ built by bounded self-construction

definition.plain: Knowledge Substrate turns a folder of raw files into a living per-topic wiki for the system itself: connector points at an external source folder; each file is registered and deterministically parsed (dates, entities, claims, patterns, intent, with source line anchors); articles are synthesized with definition, current-authority main line, timeline, idea branches, conflicting/open, historical, deprecated, and hyperlinks back to raw files. Newest source wins.
definition.role: SOCC memory organ so models read the wiki, not raw files; jump to original line only when needed

pilot.goal: one reference wiki article giving the system a complete representation of Entity Substrate, with worked-out main line and hyperlinks to every source

truth_boundary: Organ build + pilot article only. Read-only over external sources. Global route authority is not modified. No daemon/background/network/LLM/entity-birth/AGI claim.
